overview:
**Fire danger in the Montrose high-elevation zone is Low today, kept down by cool temps, scattered rain, and moist fuels (ERC 45%, BI 41%).**
- Danger stays Low through October 31, with ERC trending 39–47% and BI 36–43% as periodic rain/snow keeps fuels damp.
- Cool highs (41–47°F) and light winds (6–10 mph) through the week limit any fire spread potential.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met today, and no Red Flag Warnings or Fire Weather Watches are in effect across Colorado.
- Fire restrictions remain eased region-wide: Uncompahgre, Gunnison, and Tres Rios BLM field offices and the GMUG National Forest have all lifted Stage 1 fire restrictions, with only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules in effect.
- No active wildfires are burning in or near this area's counties; the Rocky Mountain Area's only uncontained large fire remains far north in Sheridan County, Wyoming.
